description.value: Mali Thai is a Thai restaurant on Main Street in Vancouver's Mount Pleasant neighbourhood, serving a broad menu of curries, noodles, soups, and appetizers with clearly labelled vegan, vegetarian, and gluten-free options. The restaurant offers dine-in alongside takeout and delivery through DoorDash, UberEats, Ritual, and Skipthedishes, and also accepts call-in pickup orders. Main Street is one of Vancouver's most bikeable corridors, making this a practical meal stop for cyclists riding through the city.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website is fully accessible and confirms the restaurant's address, primary phone number, and active operation. The menu explicitly labels vegan and gluten-free items, and the website's 'Take Out & Delivery' section confirms takeout via multiple platforms. No bike parking, washroom, water refill, or Wi-Fi details appear anywhere in the website content, so those fields remain null despite the OSM internet_access=wlan tag, which cannot be treated as authoritative without website corroboration.
concerns: OSM name is 'Mali Thai Food' but the website consistently uses 'Mali Thai Restaurant' — possible name discrepancy worth verifying on-site.
Website lists two different email addresses in different locations: MAIThaiFoodsCorp@gmail.com (contact/footer) and MaliThaiFoods@gmail.com (footer); minor inconsistency.
OSM tags internet_access=wlan but website does not mention Wi-Fi for customers; could not confirm.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: An active Thai restaurant on a major Vancouver cycling corridor with confirmed takeout and clearly marked vegan/GF options; a practical and appealing stop for touring cyclists.

Vegetarian / vegan / GF.detail: Menu labels multiple items as vegan (Thai Spring Rolls A1, Crispy Wontons A2, Deep Fried Tofu A3) and gluten-free (Mali Pad Thai N10, Crispy Tofu A6, Chicken Wings A7). Website notes GF items cannot be guaranteed 100% contamination-free
